title: 一眼看懂中英文更新重點
summary: 發布頁將下載放在最上方，中英文各列精簡重點，完整說明可按需展開。
highlights: 繁體中文與英文各顯示最多三項主要更新，減少重複說明。
所有功能與使用方法保留於折疊區，重要更新提醒仍直接顯示。
usage: 開啟新版 GitHub Release，從頁面上方下載 Windows x64 套件；需要完整功能說明與驗證資訊時，展開下方「完整說明與技術資訊」。

en.title: Scan release highlights in Chinese and English
en.summary: Find the Windows download first, scan concise highlights in Chinese or English, and expand the full details when needed.
highlights: Each language shows up to three featured changes with less repetitive text.
All changes and usage instructions remain in the collapsed details; important update notices stay visible.
en.usage: Open a new GitHub Release and use the Windows x64 download at the top. Expand Full details & technical information for all changes, instructions and verification information.
